provenance_limits: Checksums identify bytes, not authenticity of the historical HTTP collection or correctness of every old audit conclusion.
Original raw capture is retained, including invalid JSON; no silent repair or derived replacement.
Historic tests and CI statements remain dated observations and were not rerun.
No application, script, dependency, configuration or security-policy changes; no archived patch executed.
privacy_residuals: Old commits remain publicly accessible through Git history and may persist in PRs, clones, forks, caches and external copies.
Current-version correction does not erase published history; residual accepted for this stage only.
README.md, PROMPT_AUDIT_PR.md and INVENTAIRE_PR.md are unchanged; secondary attribution harmonization deferred.
Personal paths in active scripts and historical diagnostics remain outside this correction.
No private durable vault or external deletion is certified; originals retained in existing Git history and temporary audit evidence.
No claim of complete repository anonymization or security validation.
